_comment: Shared recognition contract of the two mail gates (scripts/hooks/outgoing-copy-gate.py :: is_send_invocation and scripts/email-send-gate.mjs :: isSendInvocation). The conformance test (send-invocation-conformance.test.ts) runs EVERY case through BOTH implementations and asserts both equal `expected` -- divergence between the two copies surfaces as a test failure, not an incident (SUBGATEPOZ822, msg 14289). Unparseable-input fallbacks are deliberately NOT here: the two gates fall back differently by design (copy-gate: strong literals; hard-gate: full legacy patterns) and each pins its own in its scope test. A [marveen:...] prefixu esetek Marveen fuggetlen review-probai (store/marveen-send-gate-cases.json, msg 14302) -- a 'hatar' jeloles tortenete: az ot naiv exec-alak 2026-08-22 delutan LEZARULT (expected true), a megmaradt dokumentalt korlat az elfedett/futasidoben osszerakott kod; egy kesobbi valtozasnak itt teszt-hibakent kell jelentkeznie MINDKET iranyban, a nema atbillenes a tiltott allapot. INTERAGENTHOMOGLIF923 (2026-09-23): the inter-agent `curl .../api/messages` cases STAY expected:false here -- they are NOT email sends, and NONE of the email copy rules (accents, name rule, em dash) run on them. What changed is OUTSIDE this contract: the copy gate runs a SEPARATE, homoglyph-only check on that path (outgoing-copy-gate.py :: inter_agent_homoglyph_gate), blocking on a mixed-script word and passing an uninterpretable body with a loud warning. A reader must not take the expected:false rows as 'the path is unguarded', nor that change as 'the full copy gate now runs there'.
known_agents_comment: FLEETTOFLAG1025 v4: the agent names the conformance test hands BOTH twins (KNOWN_AGENTS_OVERRIDE / setKnownAgentsOverride) instead of the install's agents/ + MAIN_AGENT_ID
